notes.key_messages:
Candidates should ensure that they are working to the required level of accuracy as specified on the front of
the examination paper. Candidates should also think about the â€˜realityâ€™ of their answers, for example
obtaining the logarithm of a negative number should raise awareness of an error in previous work. Parts in
questions are usually related with later parts often requiring the use of work done in an earlier part of the
question.
notes.general_comments:
The cohort taking this paper was small, so generalisations are difficult to make. The report will identify how
questions were expected to be answered when specific problems or strong points cannot be identified. Time
did not appear to be an issue although many candidates showed a lack of understanding of the syllabus
objectives and would benefit from working through more past papers.
